# Refactor: Unused Import (F841) in stale worktree — already resolved

## Problem statement

Linter flagged `F841` (unused local `schedule`) in a file path rooted inside a stale worktree
(`.worklog/worktrees/wl-LP-0MTHCTLAF00147IT-…`). The canonical file
`.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py` at `HEAD` passes `ruff --select F` with no findings, and the sibling tracked item `LP-0MTHMCXH40000EXK` (same F841, same logical line) is already `completed` with fix commit `9bb4fa0`. This item is therefore a stale duplicate with no remaining code change required.

## Users

- **Maintainers / CI**: want a clean lint state; this duplicate should not block or reintroduce work.
- **Refactor triage**: wants stale-worktree findings de-duplicated against canonical-path findings.

### User stories

- As a maintainer, I want stale-worktree lint findings closed without code changes when the canonical file is already clean, so triage stays accurate.
- As a reviewer, I want the work item's brief to record the verification evidence and duplicate relationship, so audit history is clear.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Verified `ruff check --select F .pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py` reports no `F841` on current `HEAD`/main checkout (evidence recorded).
- [ ] Confirmed duplicate relationship to `LP-0MTHMCXH40000EXK` (same F841, same logical location; that item `completed` at commit `9bb4fa0`).
- [ ] Confirmed the reported path is inside a non-existent worktree (`wl-LP-0MTHCTLAF00147IT-…`), not a canonical repo path; no file edit made against the stale path.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries. (No doc change expected; criterion satisfied by verification.)
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes. (No code change; verification via cached/adjacent passing state or explicit note that no test-affecting change was made.)

## Constraints

- Do not edit files under `.worklog/worktrees/**` or treat stale worktree paths as canonical.
- Keep the main-checkout file unchanged unless a fresh lint run reproduces the finding (it does not as of this intake).

## Existing state

- Reported file: `.../.worklog/worktrees/wl-LP-0MTHCTLAF00147IT-proxy-usage-analysis-report-server-side/.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py:2970` — worktree no longer exists.
- Canonical file `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py` at `HEAD` has no `F841` (verified via `ruff check --select F`).
- Duplicate item `LP-0MTHMCXH40000EXK` documents the same finding at line 2976 (line-number drift) and is `completed` via commit `9bb4fa0`.

## Desired change

- No code change. Close/complete this work item as a stale duplicate with traceability to the completed canonical item and the lint verification. If project process requires the item to advance through `in_review`/`completed`, do so without a commit (or with an empty/comment-only closure).

## Key Files

- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py` — Already clean; no edit required. Verification only.
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/.worklog` — Not edited; noted as stale path root.

## Related work

- `LP-0MTHMCXH40000EXK` — Same `F841` (`schedule` unused) at `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/tests/test_analyze_proxy_usage.py:2976`, status `completed`, fix `9bb4fa0`. **Primary duplicate**.
- `LP-0MTHCTLAF00147IT` — Parent feature whose worktree produced the stale path.
- `LP-0MTHLGTUR00053QP` — Similar refactor item reporting an F841 in the same stale worktree (`scripts/reporting.py`).

## Related work (automated report)

> Automated `find_related` run 2026-09-02 returned 3 low-signal matches (W293 in `proxy/proxy/lifecycle.py`: `LP-0MSH4C71R009OQ24`, `LP-0MSH4C76R008TSX3`, `LP-0MSH4C7BR005WRFV`; all `completed`) and 3 repo file matches (`ds4/tests/long_context_security_prompt.txt`, `proxy/README.md`, `ds4/gguf-tools/imatrix/dataset/rendered_prompts.txt`). No additional high-signal duplicates beyond the manually identified `LP-0MTHMCXH40000EXK`. Full report persisted at `.worklog/tmp/find-related-full-LP-0MTHLGVPO004DZ56.md`.

## Risks & assumptions

- Risk: Future lint reintroduction if worktree-scoped refactor scans are re-run without filtering `.worklog/**`. Mitigation: ensure linter/scan ignores `.worklog/**`.
- Scope-creep risk: Do not expand to repo-wide lint sweep; limit to closing/triaging this duplicate.
- Assumption: Line-number difference (2970 vs 2976) is drift between worktree snapshot and `HEAD`; finding is logically identical.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q: "Is this item still actionable or a stale duplicate?" — Answer (agent verification, 2026-09-02): Stale duplicate. Evidence: canonical file passes `ruff --select F`; sibling item `LP-0MTHMCXH40000EXK` already completed with fix `9bb4fa0`; reported path worktree does not exist. No interview required.
